activation: BLOCKED — environment provenance only; no fit, no seal, no sealed outcome read; main .venv untouched

install_commands: uv pip sync requirements.cpa_env.lock --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
runtime_notes: Requires a uv-MANAGED CPython 3.10 (cpython-3.10.18): cpa-tools 0.7.2's numba/llvmlite pin needs Python >=3.7,<3.11, and the pod's system /usr/bin/python3.10 lacks _tkinter (cpa/_model.py has a spurious `from tkinter import N`; the managed build bundles Tcl/Tk).

Lock derived by pinning the 2023-era stack cpa-tools 0.7.2 targets: scvi-tools==0.20.3 (has parse_use_gpu_arg; newer scvi removed it and imports the removed jaxlib.xla_extension), jax/jaxlib==0.4.38 (newest <0.5 exposing jaxlib.xla_extension), anndata<0.11 (0.10.9; anndata 0.11 removed SparseDataset), numpy 1.26.4, plus seaborn>=0.13 (0.13.2; old seaborn calls the removed matplotlib.cm.register_cmap), and scanpy + requests (imported by cpa/scvi but not pulled).

rdkit is the modern wheel (2026.3.3); cpa-tools declares the abandoned rdkit-pypi which double-installs the rdkit namespace and triggers a Boost.Python converter error — the lock excludes rdkit-pypi, so a fresh `uv pip sync` of the lock is clean.
Set MPLBACKEND=Agg for headless matplotlib at runtime.

install_commands: uv pip install torch==2.6.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple
uv pip install torch_geometric cell-gears --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124
runtime_notes: Built on the pod's system CPython 3.12; GEARS (cell-gears 0.1.2) imports cleanly with numba 0.65 / llvmlite 0.47 on 3.12.
Canonical reproduction: `uv pip sync requirements.gears_env.lock --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match`.

isolation_rationale: GEARS (torch-geometric) and CPA (scvi-tools/lightning) carry independent, frequently-conflicting torch-ecosystem constraints, and the activation-time guarded seam invokes each baseline as an isolated subprocess backend. Two per-baseline environments are therefore the correct unit of reproducibility; neither shares the main ALIVE .venv.
